title: Global Capital Summit 2026
headline: Ecuador Tech Week's flagship investment summit in Guayaquil, bringing together global investors, executives, and founders around venture capital, sustainability, and corporate innovation.

detailedOverview:
Global Capital Summit 2026 is the flagship event of Ecuador Tech Week's 4th edition, a curated high-level gathering where capital, sustainability, and executive leadership converge in strategic conversations, keynotes, panels, private networking, and investment and growth opportunities. It was held Monday, July 13, 2026, from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM in Guayaquil, Ecuador.

The event is designed to connect the actors defining the direction of capital in the new economy, ranging from venture capital firms and corporates to leaders driving innovation with measurable impact. It took place within the broader Ecuador Tech Week 2026 (July 11-19), which spans more than 120 events and roughly 12,000 attendees across Ecuador.

The program explored global investment trends, smart capital, sustainability, corporate innovation, capital raising, and international expansion, with an emphasis on how capital can accelerate real innovation, sustainable business growth, and solutions with measurable impact. Format included keynotes, panels, and private networking sessions.

More than 20 speakers were confirmed for this edition, including Gregory Shepard (CEO of Startup Science and GP at Boss Partners Capital), Jorge Hurtado (VP of Products and Innovation at Banco Guayaquil), Dolores Prado (Executive Director at Holcim), Corinne Lebrun (Chief Purpose Officer at Impacta VC), and Nicolás Di Pace (Managing Partner at ADN.VC), alongside founders and executives from Latin America's technology and finance ecosystem.

Attendance required registration through the Luma platform, and organizers noted limited capacity per experience with an approval process for joining. The exact venue address was disclosed only to registered participants, with the event located in Guayaquil, Ecuador. An optional donation was offered to guarantee a spot and support the community.

Ecuador Tech Week is a regional innovation ecosystem initiative, headquarted in Guayaquil and powered by Startup Grind, supported by partners including Agro CO2 Capital, Agrobanking, Produbanco, and Workshop Coworking.
